lines.text: You idiot! What did you just do?!
Don't move! Drop the knife right now!
I'm not with her! She's right here!
Just get to the highway... flag down a truck...
HEY! PLEASE! HELP ME! HE LOCKED ME IN HERE!
Oh my god... who are you?!
He pulled me over an hour ago! Please, open the door, he's coming!
If I stop to free them, he shoots us both. If I run... I leave them to die.
